// usage: Template for .mcp.json, which is git-ignored because it holds real tokens. Copy this file to .mcp.json and replace each <...> placeholder. Never commit the filled-in copy; CI's secret scan fails on it. mcp-compressor is fetched on demand via uvx, so `uv` on PATH is the only install (https://docs.astral.sh/uv/).
// cli-syntax: mcp-compressor 0.31.4 requires `--compression` (not --compression-level), `-H` (not --header), and a `--` separator before the backend URL/args. Backends with no real Authorization header also need a placeholder `-H Authorization=Bearer unused` — without any Authorization header mcp-compressor auto-attempts OAuth discovery and fails, since these backends don't support OAuth.

github.// note: Self-hosted github-mcp-server (native HTTP) → compressed. <github-mcp-url> is the backend's /mcp endpoint; <github-pat> is a fine-grained PAT scoped to the repos you work on.

context7.// note: Upstash SaaS — no self-hosting option. Compresses 17k → ~300 tokens. Key from https://context7.com.
